WITH telescope_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    telescref,
    AVG(modindex) as group_avg
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY telescref
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(group_avg) as overall_avg
  FROM telescope_avgs
  WHERE group_avg IS NOT NULL
),
kept_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    ta.telescref,
    ta.group_avg,
    ta.group_avg - oa.overall_avg as difference
  FROM telescope_avgs ta
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE oa.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND ta.group_avg > oa.overall_avg
),
kept_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(group_avg) as kept_avg
  FROM kept_groups
  WHERE group_avg IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  kg.telescref,
  kg.group_avg,
  kg.difference,
  CASE 
    WHEN ka.kept_avg IS NULL OR ka.kept_avg = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE kg.group_avg / ka.kept_avg
  END as ratio
FROM kept_groups kg
CROSS JOIN kept_avg ka
WHERE ka.kept_avg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CASE WHEN ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
